newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua stevedores await strike position.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua stevedores await strike position.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key grains port of Paranagua are waiting to hear from their president as to whether they will join a national strike to begin at midnight Thursday/0300 GMT Friday, an official said.
"For the time being, everything is operating normally. We are waiting to hear from our president who is currently in Santos," the union official said.

Last night, stevedores from various ports decided to call a 48-hour national strike in sympathy with their colleagues in Santos who are protesting a decision by a local steel firm to use its own workers in its private terminal at the port.
Santos stevedores began an indefinite strike as of 0700 local Tuesday, effectively paralyzing loading and unloading at the port.
The national strike would be the second in two weeks.

However, in the previous 24-hour national strike, stevedores at Paranagua only stopped work for one hour and also maintaind loading at the port's grain export terminal. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
